subject: SOC 2 Type II — Clarify audit coverage window and point-in-time evidence for May 2026
messages:
From: Tom Ellis <auditops@fintrust.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 Type II — Clarify coverage moments for May 2026 reporting period

Hi Grace / Priyom,

We're preparing the fieldwork checklist for Acme Health's SOC 2 Type II and need a few clarifications on the Redwood evidence you'll provide for the May 2026 reporting period. Specifically: 

1) Coverage window: please confirm whether the report and associated artifacts should be interpreted as inclusive of May 1, 2026 00:00:00 UTC through May 31, 2026 23:59:59 UTC (UTC boundaries). If you use local server time for end-of-day snapshots, please state which timezone(s).

2) Point-in-time artifacts: For systems that rely on in-memory or ephemeral KV caches (prefix/KV caches used by your inference runtime), do you produce end-of-day snapshots or manifests? If not, could you provide alternative artifacts that demonstrate coverage (e.g., S3 manifests, nightly log exports, compute snapshot metadata)?

3) Migration/cutover exceptions: we noticed a capacity reconfiguration around May 12 in public change logs — if there are any roll-forward/roll-back events during the period that affect capture of evidence, we'll need a bridge letter or exception description.

Attachments: SOC2-request-form.pdf (list of artifacts we usually request).

Can you confirm the inclusive boundary (UTC vs local) and let us know which of the artifacts in the attachment you can provide by May 22? If possible, propose a time for a 30-minute call to quickly align.

Thanks,
Tom
FinTrust Audit LLP

On Thu, May 14, 2026 at 09:12 AM Tom Ellis <auditops@fintrust.com> wrote:
> (See above)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <auditops@fintrust.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-14T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — Clarify coverage moments for May 2026 reporting period

Tom — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front and then details below: 

- Coverage window: we can confirm May 1, 2026 00:00:00 UTC through May 31, 2026 23:59:59 UTC as the inclusive reporting window.
- Point-in-time artifacts: our inference runtime uses a combination of persistent S3 logs, nightly persistence for some caches, and ephemeral in-memory KV caches that are not routinely persisted. For ephemeral caches we can provide ancillary evidence (request/response logs, request IDs, and cache-miss rates) plus any available KV-dump pointers where persistence was enabled.
- Migration/cutover: there was an autoscaling adjustment on May 12 that caused a short window where ephemeral cache dumps were not created for a subset of instances. We can draft a bridge letter explaining the operational reason and provide compensating evidence (S3 logs, instance lifecycle events, and checksum manifests).

Details/Artifacts we propose to supply by May 22: 
- S3 object listing: s3://redwood-audit/2026-05/ with an index manifest containing object names, timestamps and MD5 checksums (will provide CSV manifest).
- Compute instance snapshots: metadata table with instance-id, launch-time, AMI id and snapshot_ts for the nightly images of inference nodes.
- Nightly persistence pointers: for persistent caches we store a pointer file under the audit prefix; we'll include the pointer list and retrieval instructions.
- Request/response logs: per-route logs with request IDs that can be matched to a sample of token-generation events for point checks.

Would FinTrust accept the S3 manifest + compute snapshot metadata + a signed bridge letter for the May 12 autoscaling event as sufficient for the point-in-time verification where ephemeral cache dumps are missing? If not, please specify additional evidence you require. 

I've attached a quick CSV with the proposed manifest layout (proposed-evidence-manifest.csv) and can schedule a 30-minute sync Thu or Fri afternoon PST.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference

> On Thu, May 14, 2026 at 09:12 AM Tom Ellis <auditops@fintrust.com> wrote:
> > (Initial request)
From: Tom Ellis <auditops@fintrust.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Chen <security@acmehealth.com>, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-15T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — Clarify coverage moments for May 2026 reporting period

Grace — appreciate the rapid response and the proposed artifacts. A couple follow-ups from our side: 

1) Confirming the reporting boundary: we accept a UTC-based inclusive interpretation (May 1 00:00:00 UTC through May 31 23:59:59 UTC) but need you to explicitly state that in the evidence manifest header (so we can map object timestamps to the window).

2) Point checks: for the ephemeral cache gaps, our procedures require either a) a persisted snapshot for the specific point(s) we choose, or b) a bridge letter plus compensating evidence that allows us to reasonably conclude the control operated. The compensating evidence you listed (S3 manifests, compute snapshot metadata, request/response logs) sounds appropriate — can you commit to providing a sample mapping (request ID -> S3 object path or instance snapshot id) for 5 randomly selected requests in the window?

3) Timezone & cutoff: if any of the nightly persistence jobs run on local node time (e.g., PST/UTC-7), call that out in the manifest. If all timestamps in S3 are in UTC (recommended), state that explictly.

4) Bridge letter: please include a short statement of the event, the affected subsystem (ephemeral KV cache), impacted dates/times, number of affected instances, and the compensating evidence locations. We'll review the draft and sign off or request edits.

Propose a quick call Fri 10:00 AM PST to sample a mapping and confirm the manifest headers. Lisa — looping you in so Acme's security team knows the plan.

Thanks,
Tom
FinTrust Audit LLP

> On Fri, May 14, 2026 at 11:03 AM Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com> wrote:

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-05-16T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — Clarify coverage moments for May 2026 reporting period

Tom / Lisa — thanks, and happy to confirm next steps. Per our conversation: 

1) Coverage window confirmation (official statement): Redwood confirms that the May 2026 SOC 2 evidence set should be interpreted as inclusive of May 1, 2026 00:00:00 UTC through May 31, 2026 23:59:59 UTC. The header of the audit manifest will include this exact boundary and a UTC timestamp format declaration.

2) Artifact delivery: we will deliver the following artifacts to the shared drive and update the manifest header with the UTC boundary by close of business May 22: 
   - s3://redwood-audit/2026-05/manifest.csv (object name, object_ts_utc, size, md5)
   - compute_snapshot_metadata.csv (instance-id, launch_ts_utc, snapshot_id, ami_id)
   - nightly_persistence_pointers.csv (pointer file path, pointer_ts_utc)
   - sample_request_mappings.csv (five request_id -> s3_object/instance_snapshot mappings)

3) Bridge letter: attached a draft bridge letter (bridge-letter-draft.docx) that documents the May 12 autoscaling event affecting ephemeral KV cache dumps. The draft includes: event timeline, number of affected instances (12), compensating evidence locations (manifest paths), and a control owner signature block. Please review and advise edits.

4) Timezone note: all S3 timestamps and CSV headers will be in UTC. If any node-level maintenance jobs ran in local time we will include a note in the manifest; but the primary evidence files will be in UTC to avoid ambiguity.

5) Logistics: evidence will be uploaded to the folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-audit-2026-05 and we will send a DocuSign link for the bridge letter acceptance if needed.

If that plan works for FinTrust and Acme, we'll proceed and set the delivery date to May 22 COB. I'll be on the Fri 10:00 AM PST call if you want to walk through sample mappings.

Thanks — Grace
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: bridge-letter-draft.docx, evidence-delivery-plan.md
